profile.facility_type_note: Part of Digital Realty's Silicon Valley (Santa Clara/San Jose area) data center campus, one of the company's largest US clusters. Two facilities in this group carry independent historic significance: 360 Spear Street and 365 Main Street in San Francisco are separate, well known carrier hotel buildings; 365 Main Street was the site of a widely covered July 2007 power outage that took down major web services including Craigslist and other sites hosted there, later becoming a Digital Realty/Digital Realty-heritage asset. SJC10 is documented at 1100 Space Park Drive per Digital Realty's own site.

reading.body:
SJC37 is a 399,500 square foot facility in Santa Clara with N+2 cooling redundancy, but its power capacity is not published. Digital Realty has not disclosed the megawatts available to this building, making it impossible to estimate its rack or accelerator count from public information.

California has 103 mapped data center facilities, of which only 11 publish power capacity figures totaling 365 MW. This campus ranks 12th among published capacity sites in the state, which means its unpublished capacity either exceeds all 11 disclosed facilities or the ranking reflects a broader Digital Realty campus rather than SJC37 alone.

Without published power specifications, this facility cannot be assessed for its role in AI scaling. The operator's decision not to disclose megawatts is itself notable given that transparency on grid impact is becoming standard practice among peers seeking to clarify infrastructure constraints on compute growth.
